recentItems.title: Friends in Disguise / Down Memory Lane / Mini Golf Mayhem | Chip 'n' Dale: Park Life S2 E4
recentItems.description:
Dale's behaviour is getting on Chip's nerves and vice versa. To take a break from his partner Chip heads to a local bar and disguises himself as a frog to get in. He even makes some new friends! Little does he know, Dale had the same idea... / While going through a photo album, Chip and Dale have different memories of how things happened. Each of them remembers themselves in a more heroic fashion than the other resulting in an epic encounter. / Dale doesn’t want the party to end, so when Chip wants to go to sleep Dale takes his friends to the new minigolf course to keep the party going. When they all get too tired to continue Chip offers them a chance to escape, but Donald discovers the intruders in his golf course and wants them to keep up the free entertainment, despite their exhaustion.
